citations.claim: controller force 41.64 exceeds 40 limit at first violating step

explanation: Controller with gains adapted to plant computes raw force ~41.64 N at step 1 from initial theta=-0.1, omega=-0.3 but clipping to force_limit 40 fails; likely gains too high / missing saturation so limit is exceeded on first control action.
vision_note: The cart stays near the center of the track with the pole nearly upright through steps 0 to 4. No fall, track exit, or sudden motion is visibly wrong.
